data.name: Afzal
data.gender_notes: Afzal is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elative of the Arabic root ف-ض-ل (f-ḍ-l), 'to excel' — 'best, most excellent'. Its root is ف-ض-ل (f-ḍ-l). A common Muslim given name. Afzal is a Arabic name meaning “Best; most excellent”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Afzal expresses “Best; most excellent”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Elative of the Arabic root ف-ض-ل (f-ḍ-l), 'to excel' — 'best, most excellent'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afzal total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
